_note: Free food and non-alcoholic beverages an employer provides: "the amount of expenditure incurred by such employer as reduced by the amount, if any, paid or recovered from the employee" (D-117; rulebook PERQ-MEAL-2026, alias PERQ-FOOD-BEVERAGES). Food outside the exclusions is salary in full; tea or snacks at work, and food at work in a remote area or off-shore installation, are not salary (nil lines citing this row); paid vouchers in a regime PERQ-MEAL-VOUCHER does not apply in are valued here in full. For every employee (s.17(1)(e); 1961 s.17(2)(viii); D-116 C2). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.15(5) Table IV Sl. 3 (Gazette 271092, pp.1545–1546). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.3(7)(iii) (consolidated rule 3, pp.3–4). Every regime.
